base.summary: Storage deficit and GB tightness persist; US diesel ban threat and reserve releases remain in negotiation. TTF stable 72–75 EUR/MWh; DE Power 155–165 EUR/MWh.

downside.summary: G7 reserve releases executed swiftly and at full scale; US diesel ban deferred or exempts allies. Refined product tightness eases, heating demand softens, power merit-order improves.

upside.summary: US diesel export ban announced with limited carve-outs; G7 reserve release delayed or scaled back. Heating fuel costs spike, driving gas-to-heat switching and winter demand.

themes: GB power extended; EU storage deficit
